original_extraction.evidence_text:
Folkways Session recorded the night of July 21-22 1956, by V.P. and R. Gordon
Wasson in the home of Cayetano Garcia of Huautla de Jiménez, Oaxaca (Mushroom
Ceremony of The Mazatec Indians of Mexico, Folkways Records and Service
Corporation, NYC, U.S.A., FR 8975). Translation from Mazatec into Spanish by
Alvaro Estrada and Eloina Estrada de Gonzalez. English verson by Henry Munn.

generation_rules: Use first-person declarations of identity and spiritual roles
Include references to natural and spiritual motherhood
pause_rules: Not explicitly stated in the text; humming indicates a softer, possibly contemplative pause
original_extraction.psychological_function: Reinforcement of identity and connection with sacred feminine and spiritual figures, fostering a sense of belonging and spiritual alignment
repetition_rules: Repeated phrases emphasizing preparation and sanctity of the soul
Repetition of titles and symbolic names to reinforce spiritual presence
original_extraction.therapeutic_function: Invocation of spiritual and healing entities through chant to promote purification and preparation of the soul
voice_rules: Alternation between spoken and hummed expressions
Use of affirming and declarative statements
